title: Member messages: a double tap, the sending state, the page refreshing by itself, the empty page and the 180-day line are never tested
what: The Member messages screen test sends one reply as the owner and marks one message done. No test taps Send reply twice, checks the Sending state with both buttons greyed, waits for the page to read the list again by itself, opens the page with no messages, or looks for the line saying messages are deleted after 180 days. The front desk and a trainer never reply or mark done on screen; only the server checks cover that.
expected: Screen tests cover a double tap on Send reply, the Sending state, the refresh by itself without wiping a reply being typed, the empty page for the owner and the trainer, the 180-day line, and the desk and a trainer marking a message done.
fix_line: Add screen checks for the double tap, the sending state, the refresh by itself, the empty page, the 180-day line and staff marking done

title: The Members list chips, the 'Has dues' list and its 'WhatsApp all, one by one' sheet are never tested on screen
what: No screen test checks the chip counts on Members against the rows, that 'Has dues' includes archived members who owe money, that a home tile opens the list with its own chip, or that a renewal moves a member between Expired and Active. The 'WhatsApp all, one by one' sheet on Members (with '0 sent so far' and the left-out short numbers) is never opened. No test opens Members signed in as the front desk.
expected: Screen tests compare each chip with its rows, open 'Has dues' with an archived member who owes, follow a home tile into Members, use the one-by-one sheet, and open Members as the front desk.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the Members chips, Has dues with an archived member, a home tile, the one-by-one sheet and the desk view

title: The 'Joined in the app' tab is only tested for two taps
what: One test taps an app member to open their page and taps another to open Add member. Nothing checks the gym code line, the orders and shop money on each card, the empty page, the not-online card, a failed read, the list refreshing by itself, that the add form comes with the name and number filled in, or what the front desk sees on this tab.
expected: Screen tests check the card lines, the empty, not-online and failed-read pages, the refresh by itself, the filled-in add form, and the tab as the front desk.
how_often: whenever a member joins in the app
fix_line: Add screen tests for the Joined in the app tab's cards, empty and error pages, refresh, filled add form and desk view

title: A past time for a timed message, sending when nobody has the app, and a failed send are never tested
what: The timed message test picks tomorrow 9 am and checks the words. No test types a time in the past, checks the 'Timed in the app' pill, sends when no member has the app yet, sees the warning when the day's limit is reached, or sees what happens when the send fails and the Sent list is read again.
expected: Screen tests refuse a past time, show the Timed pill, send with no member in the app, show the limit warning, and show a failed send followed by the Sent list read again.
fix_line: Add screen tests for a past time, nobody in the app, the limit warning and a failed send

title: The workout offer's 'Part of the Pro pack' card, 'already has the reward' and a removed member are never tested
what: No test opens the Workout offer on a Starter gym, so the Pro pack card and its how-to-move words are never seen, by the owner or the desk. The note when a member already has the reward, and the row for a member removed from the list, are never checked.
expected: Screen tests open the Workout offer on a Starter gym as owner and desk, give a reward twice, and show a removed member's row without their name.
fix_line: Add screen tests for the Pro pack card, a second give and a removed member

title: The receipt for a payment to MettleUp is never opened in a test
what: Only the server and a reading helper check the MettleUp receipt's figures. No test opens the receipt page and checks its lines, the Back to Pay MettleUp button, the print view, the 'Receipt not found' page for a wrong number or another gym, or what the desk and the demo see.
expected: A screen test opens a MettleUp receipt and checks every line, prints it, and opens a wrong number and another gym's number.
fix_line: Add a screen test that opens, prints and mis-opens a MettleUp receipt

title: The More page's Shop and Member questions badges and its rows for a trainer are never tested
what: No test opens More as a trainer, so Training progress and Member questions rows and their badge are never seen there. No test sees the Shop badge go up when an order comes in or down after it is handled, and no test checks that the AI Assistant, Your web page and All branches rows stay hidden when the gym lacks them.
expected: Screen tests open More as a trainer and watch the Shop and Member questions badges move, and check the hidden rows on a one-branch gym.
fix_line: Add More page tests for a trainer, the moving badges and the hidden rows
